articles.title: Tech rally, US-Taiwan chip deal, power grid auction: 3 Things
articles.mainIdea: Tech rally, US-Taiwan chip deal, power grid auction: 3 Things
articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: Tech rally, US-Taiwan chip deal, power grid auction: 3 Things. US stock futures (ES=F, NQ=F, YM=F) are perked up in Friday's premarket as the tech sector and bank stocks are looking to rally. Chip stocks are roaring to life this morning after the US struck a trade deal with Taiwan, which includes Taiwanese tech companies investing a total of $250 billion into US semiconductor manufacturing. Lastly, the Trump administration is teaming up with governors to hold an emergency power auction to resolve the surging power costs expected from Big Tech's AI data centers. To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Morning Brief. Related tickers mentioned: AMD, ASML, ASMLF, AVGO, MU, NVDA, QCOM, TSM, TSMWF, XLE, XLK.
